sanskrit_verse: योगक्षेमवतो लाभः समत्वेन विभज्यते । प्रचारश् च यथांशेन कर्तव्यो ऋक्थिभिः सदा ॥
transliteration: yogakṣemavato lābhaḥ samatvena vibhajyate / pracāraś ca yathāṃśena kartavyo rikthibhiḥ sadā //
sph_interpretive_translation: The gain accruing to one who maintains yoga (union) and kṣema (preservation) shall be equitably distributed; likewise, propagation must always be conducted proportionally by those bearing responsibility.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from sustained union and preservation capacity
Causation is established through conscious maintenance of integrity
Restoration logic aligns with equitable distribution of gains
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent maintains yoga AND kṣema, THEN agent is entitled to equitable share of collective gain
IF entity holds propagation authority, THEN distribution must occur in exact proportion to contributory capacity
IF disruption occurs in propagation process, THEN restoration protocol activates completion obligation
IF agent fails to maintain yoga-kṣema continuum, THEN exclusion from gain-sharing is automatically enforced
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that entitlement to societal benefit flows exclusively from demonstrated capacity to sustain union and preservation. Distribution mechanisms must reflect precise contributory measurement without exception.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality locates gain-generation within yoga-kṣema continuity. Disruption does not invoke penalty but necessitates cessation of participation until capacity is restored. Proportionality reflects natural law, not punitive calibration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establishment of yoga-kṣema equilibrium prior to re-entry into gain-sharing
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Mandatory resumption of disrupted function at enhanced fidelity level
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Directed realignment of operational capacity to pre-disruption integrity
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Verification of stabilized yoga-kṣema maintenance before benefit access renewal
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through consciousness-aligned distribution; reality affirmed as non-punitive; adjudication executed by yogakṣema-consciousness alone.
